reason: I'd try a couple of drop-ins because I need somewhere to take my toddler where I can sit with coffee and Wi-Fi and get a little done. A calm space with parents on site beats the loud play places. I wouldn't commit to a membership until I'd seen it.
objection: Will bigger kids be running wild around my baby? Ages 8 months to 5 is a big range, and I don't know if the little ones get their own space. I'd also want to know the Wi-Fi is decent enough to get real work done.
would_change_my_mind: A clearly separate, gated area for under-2s, or a posted cap on how many kids are in at once. That would get me to a membership.
